summary.text: Kathy Goodwin is the Working Class Party candidate for Michigan's 8th District, advanced from the party's June 6, 2026 convention. Little biographical information is available beyond a 2020 Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Goodwin said in a 2020 Ballotpedia survey that the Flint, Saginaw and Bay City area formed her and that she attended public school in Montrose, outside Flint.
